name: Path-Order and Polynomial Termination of the Kernel
description: Proves termination by LPO, MPO below phi7 and nonlinear polynomial W, while KBO variable conditions, WPO polynomial orders and Yamada tuples cannot orient the duplicating step.

program.name: The Termination Axis
program.summary: The rule recΔ b s (δ n) → app s (recΔ b s n) copies its payload and consumes one counter; a direct measure orients it exactly when it ignores the payload and increases strictly with the counter, and the additive, affine, matrix, arctic, tropical and Knuth-Bendix families fail under their stated premises, with mutual cycles and higher-order sharing as variants. The proofs that succeed change the observer: the dependency-pair projection to the counter, nonlinear coupling, and the lexicographic and multiset path orders; seventy-six methods and a residual catalog record the verdicts as bookkeeping.

oneLine: The KO7 kernel terminates by lexicographic path order, multiset path order below φ₇(0), and a nonlinear polynomial interpretation, while variable-condition KBO, bounded-polynomial and WPO-polynomial orders, and affine Yamada tuples cannot orient the duplicating recursor-successor step.
summary: The objects are KO7 traces and root steps including the duplicating rec-succ rule, symbolic schema terms dupSrc and dupTgt, lexicographic and multiset path orders, nonlinear polynomial interpretations, bounded polynomial tables, WPO direct orders, and Yamada tuples. The questions are which orders orient all steps and prove termination and which fragments are blocked by duplication where the payload occurs once in the source and twice in the target. The main positive results are that LPO with CeTA precedence orients root and full-context steps, fixed-precedence MPO orients root steps with a Veblen ranking below φ₇(0) and hence below Γ₀, and the nonlinear W and parametric Wa family orient all root steps, with infinite full-order classes among orienters. The conditions are Wa offset at least one and scaled offset and scale at least one, the fixed MPO rank order, and unboundedness plus frozen base dominance for the barriers. The main negative results are that variable-condition and positive weighted comparators, bounded polynomial measures under dominance, sound WPO polynomial direct orders under dominance, Yamada affine and additive-sum tuples, and MPO with app above recΔ cannot orient the duplicating step, while successful polynomial escape must violate base dominance.
boundary: On one side, the lexicographic path order, the fixed-precedence multiset path order and the nonlinear Wa and W with offset at least one strictly decrease along every root step, giving well-founded reverse reduction with ordinal ranks below φ₇(0). On the other side, any comparator satisfying the standard or weighted variable condition, any bounded polynomial or WPO-direct order with unbounded range plus frozen base dominance, any Yamada affine or additive-sum tuple, and MPO with app above recΔ cannot orient the duplicating step. The obstruction is the duplicated payload whose count rises from one to two: weighted s-count strictly rises and the frozen target dominates the source, located by the schema dupSrc and dupTgt theorems and their trace instantiations and by the smallest rec-succ counterexample.

conclusions.statement: Every root Step a b is oriented by LPO_KO7, every full-context StepCtxFull a b is oriented by LPO_KO7 and by the transitive LPOOrder_KO7, and the reverse full-context relation is well-founded.
For all a b with Step a b, MPO a b holds; for all a b with MPO a b, mpoOrd b is less than mpoOrd a; the reverse MPO relation is well-founded and the reverse root Step relation is well-founded.

For every Trace t, mpoOrd t is less than mpoVeblenBound; mpoVeblenBound is less than gamma0; there exists rho with rho t less than mpoVeblenBound for all t and rho b less than rho a whenever Step a b; and there exists such rho with the added conjunct mpoVeblenBound less than gamma0.
For all a b with Step a b, W b is less than W a, and the reverse Step relation fun a b => Step b a is well-founded.
Under hypothesis 1 ≤ a, for all x y with Step x y, Wa a y is less than Wa a x, and the reverse root relation fun x y => Step y x is well-founded.

For all a a-prime, a ≤ a-prime iff Wa a t ≤ Wa a-prime t for every t; for every t, Wa 1 t equals W t; for all a m, Wam a m strictly orients every Step iff 1 ≤ a and 1 ≤ m; under 1 ≤ m and 1 ≤ m-prime, Wam a m is projectively equivalent to Wam a-prime m-prime iff a equals a-prime and has the same full order iff a equals a-prime; for every N there is an injective N-indexed family each strictly orienting every Step; the full-order quotient and the root-orienter full-order quotient are infinite.
For every KBOStyleOrder K, it is false that K.gt dupSrc dupTgt, and there is no KBOStyleOrder K with K.gt dupSrc dupTgt.

For any gtT and bT sT nT, if for all x y and v, gtT (instantiate bT sT nT x) (instantiate bT sT nT y) implies countVar v y ≤ countVar v x, then it is false that gtT (recΔ bT sT (delta nT)) (app sT (recΔ bT sT nT)).
For every positive coefficient assignment C, the weighted s-count on dupSrc is less than on dupTgt, and for every weighted order O over C, it is false that O.gt dupSrc dupTgt.
With no hypotheses, it is false that MPOBad badRecSuccSrc badRecSuccTgt holds, and it is false that for all a b with Step a b, MPOBad a b holds, witnessed by the rec-succ instance at void void void.

Under hypotheses M is a BoundedPolynomialMeasure over ko7Schema with unbounded range and eventually dominated at base, M.eval does not globally orient ko7System with less-than; the same holds under succ_bias and succ_scale at least one plus dominance and under wrap bias at least one plus dominance; under unbounded range plus global orientation, M is not eventually dominated at base.

For every WPO polynomial direct order W on ko7Schema with unbounded range and eventual base dominance, W does not globally orient ko7System; the same holds under successor bias and scale at least one plus dominance and under wrap bias at least one plus dominance; if the measure is unbounded and W globally orients ko7System then eventual base dominance fails.

For every Yamada affine tuple M, it is false that its strict coordinate strictly increases from wrap to recur-successor for all b s n; for every Yamada affine order W, it is false that W orients the duplicating step for all b s n; for every such order on a system, it is false that it globally orients the system.

For every Yamada additive-sum measure M, it is false that its tuple order orients the duplicating step for all b s n, and for every such measure on a system, it is false that it globally orients the system.

W of delta void differs from W of void; there is no constant c with W of recΔ b s n equal to c + W b + W s + W n for all b s n; there are no constants alpha beta gamma delta-r with W of recΔ b s n equal to alpha + beta W b + gamma W s + delta-r W n for all b s n.

openPoints: Parametric orientation needs recursor offset at least one, and the scaled family needs offset and scale at least one.
Bounded polynomial impossibility needs unbounded range together with eventual frozen base dominance, or successor-pump or wrap-pump bias together with that dominance.
WPO direct barrier needs soundness sending gt to strict measure decrease, plus the same unboundedness and dominance hypotheses.
Yamada barriers cover affine strict-coordinate and additive-sum fragments; unrestricted or cross-coupled tuples lie outside the barrier.
MPO termination uses the fixed rank order void, delta, merge, integrate, app, eqW, recDelta; placing app above recDelta breaks global orientation.
KBO and subterm-coefficient barriers need the standard or weighted variable condition with all coefficients at least one.
Generalized WPO compatibility is recorded through the existing polynomialKBO conditional row, with residual branches closed outside the direct lane.
paperReferences: Yamada 2022 (JAR, tuple interpretations for TRS termination)

files.summary: This file packages the exact generalized-WPO compatibility statement already justified by the live RDRS surface, without formalizing a new universal theorem about generalized WPO. It defines the algebraic branch as the polynomialKBO conditional row with its named hypothesis carrier and the residual branch as closure only outside the direct lane. It proves witnesses for both branches and for the historical shim reachability. Its final theorem assembles the compatibility certificate, with a stable string anchor.
files.conclusion: Generalized-WPO is compatible only via the existing polynomialKBO conditional row, otherwise outside the direct lane.

files.summary: This file states the trace-level KBO-style impossibility as a conditional variable-count obstruction. If a concrete comparator on instantiated schema terms satisfies the standard variable condition, it cannot orient the concrete KO7 rec_succ rule instance. It forwards the count contradiction from the symbolic barrier imports.
files.conclusion: No trace-level comparator satisfying the variable condition orients the KO7 rec_succ rule instance.

files.summary: This file aliases the symbolic comparator variable-condition interface as KBOStyleOrder. Its two corollaries state that no such comparator orients the duplicating schema step and that no such comparator exists. The concrete trace specialization is left to the companion trace file.
files.conclusion: No variable-condition comparator exists that orients the duplicating schema step.

files.summary: This file defines KBO with subterm coefficients, its weighted terms, weighted variable condition and comparison relation. It gives a concrete admissible model with non-unit coefficients and two inhabited arms. It proves no admissible model orients the duplicating schema rule for any coefficients, packages the KO7 root-step obstruction, and bridges it to concrete traces.
files.conclusion: Every admissible subterm-coefficient KBO fails on the KO7 duplicating recursor-successor rule, with an explicit trace-level bridge.

files.summary: This file restores an archive-facing compatibility surface without new mathematics. It aliases the KBO comparator abstraction, records the one-versus-two payload count that blocks the duplicating rule, and forwards the already-proved schema and trace-level impossibility corollaries under archive-facing names.
files.conclusion: No KBO-style order orients the duplicating schema step or the concrete KO7 rec_succ trace instance.

files.summary: This file instantiates the generic lexicographic path order on the KO7 kernel with CeTA precedence and full lexicographic status, encoding traces as first-order terms. It proves each root rule and every full-context step is oriented by the one-step order and its transitive closure, yielding well-foundedness of full-context reduction. It also proves the order imports the subterm property while no affine compositional measure can globally orient the system, and that no such measure represents any LPO-respecting rank.
files.conclusion: The transitive LPO orients all KO7 full-context steps and proves termination, while affine measures cannot.

files.summary: This file defines first-order signatures with Nat-valued precedence, first-order terms, and the one-step LPO generator with subterm, precedence and full lexicographic clauses, plus its transitive closure as the exported order. It proves stability under substitution, monotonicity under argument updates and arbitrary one-hole contexts, and that the equal-tail clause is a subrelation of the full clause. It proves well-foundedness of the reverse orders by nested accessibility induction on rank, lexicographic argument tuples and right-hand-side size, without Kruskal or minimal bad sequences.
files.conclusion: The generic transitive lexicographic path order is stable, monotone and well-founded.

files.summary: Defines a KO7-specific multiset path order over Trace with fixed symbol precedence and subterm, precedence and same-head recΔ counter clauses. Proves each of the eight root Step rules MPO-oriented, with a master theorem that every Step is oriented. Defines a Veblen-based ordinal ranking and shows MPO steps strictly decrease it, yielding well-foundedness of reverse MPO and of reverse root Step.
files.conclusion: Every root Step is MPO-oriented and ordinal-decreasing, so reverse Step is well-founded.

files.summary: Keeps the same KO7 MPO shape but swaps precedence so app is above recΔ. Defines the smallest concrete rec_succ source and target. Proves by case analysis that no bad-MPO derivation exists for the void and delta-void prefixes and hence for that rec_succ instance, so no global root-step orientation exists under this precedence.
files.conclusion: Under app above recΔ, the KO7 MPO cannot orient all root steps.

files.summary: Introduces the explicit ordinal envelope veblen 7 0 for the fixed-signature MPO ranking and proves every mpoOrd lies below it. Witnesses root-step termination by a ranking into that initial segment. Defines gamma0 as the least fixed point of a => veblen a 0, identifies it with Mathlib gamma 0, and shows veblen 7 0 < gamma0, so the MPO proof stays below the Feferman-Schütte ordinal.
files.conclusion: All MPO ranks lie below φ₇(0) < Γ₀ with strict decrease along every root step.

files.summary: Introduces the parametric nonlinear family Wa with recursor offset a and its positive rescaling Wam, proving every member with a at least 1 orients all eight root rules and yields well-foundedness. Classifies orientation, literal equality, projective equivalence and full-order equivalence exactly by the parameters, with scale contributing no new shape. Proves unbounded discrete multiplicity and infinitely many full-order classes among actual orienters, while all orienters share one rewrite-edge order class.
files.conclusion: There are infinitely many pairwise non-equivalent full-order root orienters with scale contributing no new projective shape and all sharing one rewrite-edge order.

files.summary: Defines the nonlinear polynomial interpretation W with multiplicative recursor coupling. Proves W is everywhere positive, strictly orients all eight KO7 root rules, and yields well-foundedness of the reverse step relation. Separately proves W violates successor transparency and is neither additive nor affine in the listed senses.
files.conclusion: The nonlinear polynomial interpretation W strictly orients every KO7 root step and proves full root termination while violating transparency, additivity and affinity.

files.summary: Specializes the generalized degree-bounded polynomial barrier to KO7. Proves no global orientation under unboundedness plus frozen base dominance, with successor-pump and wrap-pump variants. States the necessary shape condition that any successful polynomial escape must violate base dominance.
files.conclusion: KO7 admits no globally orienting bounded polynomial measure under unboundedness plus frozen base dominance, via successor or wrap pumps.

files.summary: Defines finite polynomial monomials and bounded polynomial-table measures with affine succ and wrap plus a polynomial recursor table and frozen source and target polynomials at the base point. Proves the generalized barrier that unbounded range plus eventual frozen dominance rules out uniform dup-step orientation, with successor and wrap pump specializations. Lifts the barrier to global orientation and states escape requires failure of base dominance.
files.conclusion: Unbounded finite polynomial measures satisfying frozen base dominance cannot orient the duplicating step or its global system.

files.summary: Interprets abstract symbolic duplicating terms into concrete KO7 traces by mapping schema variables to traces and constructors to void, delta, app and recDelta. Proves the two displayed definitional equalities identifying the images of the duplicating source and target.
files.conclusion: Symbolic duplicating terms instantiate to the expected KO7 traces with both equalities proved definitionally.

files.summary: Defines schema variables, symbolic terms, variable-occurrence counts and the duplicating source and target with counts 1 versus 2 at the payload variable. Proves no variable-condition order can orient the duplicating rule, while exhibiting a size-plus-dominance order that is well-founded, orients the successor peel and zero rule, and rejects the duplicating rule.
files.conclusion: No variable-condition order orients the duplicating rule, yet the class is nonempty with a well-founded member orienting non-duplicating rules.

files.summary: Extends the symbolic barrier with argument coefficients, weighted occurrence counts and subterm-coefficient positivity, computing the payload counts as recur2 versus wrap1+wrap2*recur2. Proves the weighted condition fails for every positive assignment, shows each wrapper positivity is load-bearing via degenerate assignments, and recovers the unweighted count at unit coefficients.
files.conclusion: The weighted variable condition fails for all positive assignments with both wrapper positivities load-bearing, and unit coefficients recover the unweighted barrier.

files.summary: This file specializes the bounded polynomial barrier to WPO polynomial direct orders on KO7. It proves three no-global-orientation corollaries under unbounded, successor-pump, and wrap-pump assumptions with eventual base dominance. It proves any successful global orienter must violate base dominance.
files.conclusion: No WPO polynomial direct order with unbounded measure and base dominance globally orients KO7, and escape requires failure of base dominance.

files.summary: This file packages the schema-generic half of the WPO direct polynomial-branch barrier. It defines direct orders sound for a bounded polynomial measure. It proves unbounded, successor-pump, and wrap-pump barriers plus escape-requires-failure of base dominance and a global lift.
files.conclusion: No sound direct WPO polynomial order orients the duplicating step under the stated unbounded and dominance hypotheses.

files.summary: This file defines Yamada tuples with an affine strict coordinate and orders sound for them. It proves no such tuple or order orients the duplicating schema step or globally, by reduction to the affine barrier. It exhibits a width-one free-schema size witness showing the fragment is nonempty and nonconstant.
files.conclusion: No Yamada affine strict-coordinate tuple or order orients the duplicating step, with a nonempty width-one witness.

files.summary: This file records the additive-sum fragment of Yamada tuple interpretations ordered by weak decrease plus strict sum decrease. It proves no such tuple orients the duplicating step or globally, since strict orientation would induce a forbidden additive orientation. It proves the weak order is a precongruence and every additive measure lifts to a one-dimensional Yamada witness.
files.conclusion: No additive-sum Yamada tuple orients the duplicating step or globally, while the class is inhabited by one-dimensional lifts.

files.summary: This file provides reach tests for GeneralizedWPOCompatibility. It checks the algebraic-branch and out-of-direct-lane types and constructions and the exact compatibility statement with its module anchor. It also proves two examples exhibiting inhabitants of the branch and lane types.
files.conclusion: Both the algebraic-branch and out-of-direct-lane witnesses inhabit their types under exact WPO compatibility.

files.summary: This file is a reachability check for the PolyInterpretation family module. It elaborates parametric weights, orienting families, proportionality and projective-equivalence characterizations, and nonproportionality witnesses. It also checks full-order and step-order setoids and quotients, root-orienter quotients and infinitude, and strict-recoding separations. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
files.conclusion: The file confirms that every named PolyInterpretation family declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.
